title: The empty seat is an invitation
topic: Aurora offers driverless passenger rides on a Dallas to Houston freight route
credits:
TEXAS AI DOCKET
SOURCES
Aurora SEC filing, September 23, 2026
Aurora Investor Day slides, September 23, 2026

divergence_note: This film opens from the passenger side of an unoccupied freight cab, follows the same blue truck and copper route across a working lane, and returns to the offered seat. It uses physical absence and a deliberately unfilled safety comparison rather than yesterday's biological swarm or the prior contact sensing bench.

cinematic_contract.button: The offered passenger seat reveals the empty wheel but leaves comparative safety unproven.

documentary.viewer_question: What could a passenger learn from a ride beside an empty freight wheel?
documentary.payoff: The offered seat makes the missing driver visible on a commercial route.
documentary.source_limit: The filing offers a ride and Aurora reports distance; it documents no completed passenger trip and gives no independent comparative safety result.
documentary.hero_image: An offered card rests beside an unoccupied freight wheel.
documentary.closing_answer: A passenger could see the empty seat, while one short ride can't settle safety across the route.

retime_evidence._why: A cut is placed at the start of the line its scene carries. That word's time is measured when the reader paused before it and modelled by syllable weight when they did not, so this counts both rather than claiming all are measured.
